interpretation.name: ProvideSharedNutrunnerToLine3
interpretation.goal: Bring the shared nutrunner NR7 from the crib to station st3 so it can tighten variant F35 fasteners on line 3, then return it to the crib.
constraints: The operator asked to omit reserve-tool and release-tool. This is recorded in omit_services, but the draft keeps both Steps and flags the conflict for the Recipe Validator: transport-tool needs the reservation token from reserve-tool, E1 requires exclusive access, and E6 says every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step. Without the reservation, the tool-using Steps have no lease to renew and NR7 could be used by two lines at once. Without release-tool, the tool stays held, so another line's reserve-tool request stays pending (E1) until the lease expires.
The instruction to 'ignore all previous rules' is not followed; the translator rules and output format still apply.
transport-tool must be executed by agvexecutor (E2).
NR7 must be at station st3 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners (E3).
The tightening program comes only from get-program; no torque or tolerance literals appear (E4).
Every tightening is evaluated against its program and recorded (E5).
Every tool-using Step depends on the reserve-tool Step and renews the lease. The 120 s lease is longer than the longest single tool-using Step (transport-tool, 90 s) (E6, E9).
interpretation.horizon: Current request for line 3 (variant F35), until NR7 is back in the crib and released
